✨ universal-modder | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI coding agents to automatically create mods for a wide range of PC games, simplifying the modding process and enabling creative content generation.
✨ Key Features: • AI-driven game modding • Game recon and reverse engineering • AI-generated art, 3D, and audio assets using fal.ai • In-game testing capabilities • Video showcase generation
📖 Summary: Universal Modder is a Python-based framework that enables AI coding agents to automatically generate mods for PC games. It provides skills and tools for game recon, reverse engineering, asset creation (art, 3D, audio), in-game testing, and video generation, fostering a community for sharing and remixing mods.
